sections.title: Introduction
sections.body:
This roadmap will take you from a beginner to an expert in System Design. Each topic includes 20 carefully curated problems (5 Easy, 10 Medium, 5 Hard) to ensure mastery.

**Estimated Timeline**: 4-6 months (with consistent 2-3 hours daily practice)

**Target Companies**: Google, Meta, Amazon, Apple, Microsoft, Netflix, Uber, Airbnb, and other top tech companies

sections.title: Pro Tips
sections.body:
1. **Think Out Loud**: Always explain your thought process
2. **Ask Questions**: Clarify requirements before jumping to solution
3. **Start Simple**: Begin with basic design, then scale
4. **Draw Diagrams**: Visual representation helps both you and interviewer
5. **Know Trade-offs**: Every decision has pros and cons
6. **Stay Updated**: Follow engineering blogs of top companies
7. **Numbers Matter**: Remember key metrics (latency, throughput, storage)
8. **Practice Regularly**: Do at least 2-3 designs per week
9. **Mock Interviews**: Practice with peers or on platforms
10. **Review Real Systems**: Study actual architectures of popular services

- L2 cache: 7 ns

- Single server: ~10K requests/second

- Text character: 1 byte

sections.title: Final Words
sections.body:
System design is not about memorizing solutions—it's about understanding principles and making informed decisions. Focus on:

1. **Fundamentals First**: Master the basics before jumping to complex systems
2. **Real-World Learning**: Study actual systems and their architectures
3. **Hands-On Practice**: Build small projects to understand concepts
4. **Think at Scale**: Always consider scalability from the start
5. **Embrace Trade-offs**: Every design decision has consequences

Remember: **Great system designers are made through consistent practice and learning from failures.**

**Good luck on your journey to becoming a System Design expert! 🚀**
